actualArguments.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
r=subprocess.run(['docker','image','inspect','sha256:07892c65089b8d11c50b50931a09fb9600a13e0909af4a2b3e27029ab16f1e6f'],capture_output=True,timeout=15);assert r.returncode==0
v=json.loads(r.stdout);assert len(v)==1
x=v[0];c=x.get('Config',{});print(json.dumps(dict(scope='READ_ONLY_IMAGE_FIELDS_ONLY_NO_CONTAINERS_CREATED',id=x['Id'],architecture=x.get('Architecture'),os=x.get('Os'),user=c.get('User'),entrypoint=c.get('Entrypoint'),cmd=c.get('Cmd'))))
PY
actualArguments.justification: Opravené read-only čítanie voliteľných polí pripnutého obrazu po chybe formátovania; bez spustenia kontajnera a bez výpisu environment premenných.
